summary.text: Scott Girardin is an Independent candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Stephen Wood.

paragraphs.text: Girardin ran for the same seat in 2024 as a Maine Independent and lost to Wood, receiving 2,019 votes (38.4 percent) to Wood's 3,239 (61.6 percent).
